observations.observation: Model is seated on a white toilet fixture placed on a pedestal in a surreal floral/cloudy background; no clothing product is visible as the central subject.
observations.impact: Violates Tmall main image requirement that the服饰 (apparel) must be the dominant, clearly presented commercial subject; non-apparel object (toilet) dominates composition.

observations.observation: The pink dress worn by the model is present but partially obscured and not the visual focus; the toilet and floating platform draw primary attention.
observations.impact: Fails product prominence standard: apparel must occupy ≥60% of visual weight and be clearly identifiable as the sold item.

observations.observation: Text overlays include 'Photographic works Year2022_', 'Cooperative brand', '快门先生', '九牧厨卫', and copyright notices—none are approved Tmall promotional templates or brand-authorized selling points.
observations.impact: Clutters main image with non-commercial, attributional, or third-party branding, reducing selling-point clarity and violating platform template constraints.

observations.observation: Visible text '九牧厨卫' (Jiumu Kitchen & Bath) identifies a home appliance brand, conflicting with the apparel context and implying misattribution or unauthorized cross-category use.
observations.impact: Creates consumer confusion about product category and brand ownership, risking trust and compliance penalties.
